title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - NetworkInterface
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/NetworkInterface. [COSEM] This class holds the MAC address of the physical device (or, more generally, of a device or software). There shall be an instance of this class for each network interface of the physical device.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NetworkInterface'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code uniquely identifying this network interface COSEM object.
